relationships.subject: GelMAMAVP MPs
relationships.evidence_quote: GelMA<sup>MAVP</sup> MPs distributed in the peripheral nerve stumps indirectly downregulated pain-related proteins (TRPA1/CGRP) in dorsal root ganglia

key_findings: Anti-VEGFR2 peptide microspheres in a conduit suppressed p-VEGFR2, angiogenesis, and scar, and outperformed vandetanib for mechanical allodynia.
Treatment indirectly reduced TRPA1/CGRP in DRG and spinal microglial activation.
